name: Namekagon River (St. Croix National Scenic Riverway)
blurb: The Namekagon River in the St. Croix National Scenic Riverway between NPS and Wisconsin DNR-listed landings, with NPS paddling-guide river miles and dam portages.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

notices.title: Start below Namekagon Dam
notices.text: Use the designated downstream canoe launch at Namekagon Dam. The NPS guide notes numerous beaver dams and low bridges in the upper river; low water can make passage difficult. Check current conditions and be prepared to carry.

notices.text: NPS Namekagon paddling guide: "It is usually possible to get a canoe under the low bridge at Leonard Schoolhouse Road (N84.7), but there is also a portage to the right."

notices.title: Portage information
notices.text: NPS Namekagon paddling guide: "A chute at the old Pacwawong Dam site (N82.2) can be canoed during high water or look for a portage to the right." (WDNR dam record 'Pac-Wa-Wong'.)

notices.title: Portage information

notices.title: Portage information
notices.text: NPS Namekagon paddling guide, Hayward Lake (N68.0): "At the end of the lake, you must portage (on left) the dam. Be careful as the portage is sometimes slippery." (WDNR dam record 'Hayward'.)
notices.sourceName: NPS St. Croix NSR — Paddling Guide to the Namekagon River (distance chart)

notices.title: Mandatory Trego portage
notices.text: Follow the signed right-bank carry around Trego Dam shown on the NPS map. Stay out of the dam approach and spillway.

sections.routeReview: Trego Dam requires a signed right-bank portage. The map shows access points; a continuous dotted river path is withheld across the dam.
